title: Lamb and Algerian Wrap
description: A keto-friendly wrap filled with lamb and Algerian spices, served with crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Algerian spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: Exotic lettuce
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild lettuce like romaine

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan to medium-high heat.
2. Add olive oil and cook the lamb mince until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
3. Add Algerian spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Add crunchy vegetables and cook until they start to soften.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Warm the wraps according to package instructions.
7. Assemble the wraps by spooning the lamb mixture onto the center of each wrap, leaving a 2-inch border around the edges.
8. Top with exotic lettuce and fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling.
9. Fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
